learning_outcomes.text: Students possess a broad fundamental knowledge of calculation techniques and mathematical procedures and methods related to computer science.

Students can apply standard mathematical procedures related to computer science. They can describe and solve simple domain-specific problems using mathematical methods (modeling and problem-solving competence).

assessment_rules: The choice of examination form from the given options is up to the respective lecturer, adhering to the valid study regulations. The composition of the portfolio examination can be found in the valid study regulations. The written work sample in the portfolio examination consists of approx. 10 tasks. For the written exam, refer to the valid study regulations.
